pmrReader.note: The two IDs occupy distinct record members. The diagnostic label is not an on-disk PMR field-name string.

mdb.note: File/source and associated master objects use the same named property; ownership and object role establish its meaning. Numeric dictionary IDs are file-local.

pmr.note: Packed positional records. MediaMuster's FileMobId/MasterMobId locator labels are assigned by its reader, not read as PMR dictionary names.

limits: The research covered relevant public Avid user/developer/format documents, not every Avid publication or a complete public PMR schema.
Avid spelling varies across documentation: File Mob ID, FilemobID and FileMobID are all observed.
Native addresses describe the inspected Media Composer version and arm64 slice; physical offsets describe the universal library.
MDB property names and PMR record positions describe inspected specimens, not every possible database version.
A name's occurrence alone does not establish ownership; roles are corroborated by native methods, format relationships and genuine cross-source examples.
KelpieId remains MediaMuster's separate scan/session physical-row identity.
